notes.title: Bug Fixes | Version 1.3
notes.notes:
Hey Typers,

I hope you are having fun with the game! I was made aware of a few bugs by kazoo (thank you) in our Discord community.



Fixes:

Twitch chat integration

Twitch viewers can order Sodas

The ticket now recognises BBQ Sauce order through Twitch

Alt-tabbing out of the game now does not lose focus of the text input field



Have a nice,

~ Jiri
